articles.title: India-ASEAN Digital Work Plan 2026: Focus on AI Governance and Cyber Resilience
articles.summary: India and ASEAN adoption of a new digital roadmap prioritizing cross-border data flows, ethical AI frameworks, and critical infrastructure protection.
prelims: The ASEAN-India Digital Ministers Meeting (ADGMIN) oversees the joint work plan implementation.
Focus areas include digital public infrastructure (DPI) interoperability using India's UPI and DigiLocker frameworks.
Cooperation extends to establishing joint Computer Emergency Response Teams (CERT) for regional threat monitoring.
articles.mains: Examine how India's Digital Public Infrastructure export strategy serves as a key pillar of Act East Policy and soft power diplomacy in Southeast Asia.

articles.title: National Carbon Market Framework Notified for Hard-to-Abate Sectors
articles.summary: Ministry of Power publishes operational guidelines for India's Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) targeting heavy industries.
prelims: The Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) acts as the administrator for carbon intensity target settings.
Covers heavy industries including steel, cement, petrochemicals, and aluminum under mandatory compliance targets.
Grid Controller of India Limited (Grid-India) acts as the registry for tracking carbon credit certificates (CCCs).
articles.mains: Discuss the potential of the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) in balancing India's net-zero commitments with industrial economic growth.

articles.title: CWC Launches Real-Time Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) Monitoring Network
articles.summary: Central Water Commission deploys automated weather stations and water-level sensor networks across high-risk Himalayan glacial lakes.
prelims: Focuses on high-altitude glacial lakes in Sikkim, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
Integrates satellite radar altimetry from ISRO with ground-based early warning acoustic sensors.
National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA) serves as the primary coordinating agency for downstream alert systems.
articles.mains: Analyze the vulnerability of Himalayan infrastructure to climate-induced cascading hazards like GLOFs and suggest mitigation strategies.

articles.title: Implementation of AgriStack: Unified Farmer Service Interface Launched
articles.summary: Government launches the digital framework for federated AgriStack to streamline credit access, crop insurance, and minimum support price payouts.
prelims: AgriStack provides a unique ID (Farmers' ID) linked to land record databases across participating states.
Includes three foundational registries: Farmers Registry, Village Land Maps Registry, and Crop Sown Registry.
Built under the Digital Agriculture Mission to eliminate documentation friction for institutional credit.
articles.mains: Critically evaluate the role of digital technology in transforming Indian agriculture while addressing data privacy and digital divide concerns.

articles.title: Successful Qualification Test of Semi-Cryogenic Engine for Heavy Payload Lift Capability
articles.summary: ISRO successfully conducts a long-duration hot test of the 2000 kN semi-cryogenic engine at the IPRC test facility in Mahendragiri.
prelims: The semi-cryogenic engine uses refined kerosene (Isorocket) as fuel and Liquid Oxygen (LOX) as oxidizer.
Designed to replace the L110 liquid stage in LVM3 (GSLV Mk III) to significantly increase payload capacity to GTO.
Operates on an efficient staged combustion cycle system.
articles.mains: How does indigenous technological self-reliance in heavy-lift launch vehicles bolster India's position in the global commercial space market?
